column1: # wiring_seam_files.tsv — the declared seam files the FR-019 wiring sweep
# treats as EXECUTION POINTS THAT CAN REFUSE.
# <seam-id> is drawn from the E5 closed set restated in
# rule_seam_bindings.tsv. A near-miss id is REFUSED, not silently ignored.
# ── Why this is a DATA file and not a list inside the gate ──────────────────
# The gate is shared constitution-side tooling (§11.4.177): it must carry no
# project literal. Every path below is this consumer's, supplied as DATA per
# §11.4.35. A different consumer ships a different file and the gate is
# ── Measured, 2026-08-21, with a control needle proving the scan sees ───────
# Exactly ONE gate is referenced from a non-comment line of any file below:
# Everything else that is bound is bound by DATA DISPATCH (see
# wiring_data_dispatch.tsv), not by a literal reference.
# The E5 seam `manual-qa-handoff` has NO identified seam file on this tree.
# It is therefore absent below rather than pointed at a plausible-looking
# file. No gate can currently bind to it, and the sweep says so rather than
# implying coverage that does not exist.
# post_update_hook.sh is the script post-merge delegates to (§11.4.164 / §11.4.32 pull seam); it invokes
# cm_hub_engine_no_ownorg_nesting.sh and cm_llmctl_submodule_nonrecursive.sh by literal basename (added 2026-10-21),
# and cm_helix_deps_manifest_present.sh (§11.4.31, pointed at the consumer PROJECT_ROOT; added 2026-10-21).
